back.heading: How To Cook

steps.en: Boil 400ml of water in a pot.
Add the noodle cake, cook 3 minutes.
Drain, season to taste, serve hot.

back.ingredients: Noodles: Wheat Flour, Water, Palm Oil, Salt, Thickener (INS 412), Humectant (INS 451 (i)), Acidity Regulator (INS 500 (i), INS 501 (i)).
back.ingredientsMs: Mi: Tepung Gandum, Air, Minyak Kelapa Sawit, Garam, Pemekat (INS 412), Humektan (INS 451 (i)), Pengawal Asid (INS 500 (i), INS 501 (i)).
back.ingredientsZh: 面：面粉、水、棕榈油、食用盐、增稠剂 (INS 412)、|保湿剂 (INS 451 (i))、酸度调节剂 (INS 500 (i), INS 501 (i))。
back.methodHeading: CARA PENYEDIAAN / PREPARATION METHOD|烹饪方法：
back.methodMs: Masukkan mi ke dalam 400ml air mendidih dan masak selama 3 minit. Kacau perlahan-lahan. Keluarkan mi dan tuskan. Hidangkan serta merta atau masukkan hiasan mengikut selera.
back.method: Put noodles into 400ml of boiling water. Simmer for 3 minutes with gentle stirring. Drain the water away. Serve immediately or may add with garnishing for taste.
back.methodZh: 将面条放入400毫升沸水中。用小火慢煮3分钟，轻轻搅拌。|把水滤干后，趁热享用或可以添加调味料增添口味。
